articles.title: Thalamocortical bursts encode reward contingencies and drive associative learning
articles.abstract: Abstract Learning requires adaptive changes in neuronal circuits, but how neurons encode learning content in their activity patterns to construct memories remains poorly understood. Using longitudinal multi-site recordings in freely moving male mice performing a sensory discrimination task, we discover the emergence of burst-coding neurons (BCNs) across cortical, thalamic, and extrathalamic regions. BCNs encoded task rules through the presence or absence of bursts, with their proportion increasing as learning progressed. Decoding analyses reveal that BCNs act as the principal carriers of rule information within the thalamocortical system. BCN burst rates scaled with stimulus valence, collapsed when contingencies were degraded, and inverted after repeated rule reversals, demonstrating that bursts dynamically track associative context during learning. Indeed, pharmacological and focal genetic suppression of thalamocortical bursting disrupted learning and task performance, establishing neuronal bursts as context-sensitive drivers of associative learning. These findings identify a burst-based neural code for stimulus–outcome associations in the thalamocortical system and provide causal evidence linking cellular firing dynamics to reward contingency learning.
articles.title_zh: 丘脑皮质爆发编码奖励意外事件并驱动联想学习
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 学习需要神经元回路的适应性变化，但神经元如何在其活动模式中编码学习内容以构建记忆仍然知之甚少。通过对执行感觉辨别任务的自由活动的雄性小鼠进行纵向多部位记录，我们发现皮质、丘脑和丘脑外区域出现了突发编码神经元（BCN）。 BCN 通过是否存在突发来编码任务规则，其比例随着学习的进展而增加。解码分析表明，BCN 是丘脑皮质系统内规则信息的主要载体。 BCN 爆发率随刺激效价的变化而变化，当意外事件恶化时，BCN 爆发率会崩溃，并且在规则反复逆转后会发生反转，这表明爆发率在学习过程中动态跟踪关联上下文。事实上，丘脑皮质爆发的药理学和局部遗传抑制扰乱了学习和任务表现，将神经元爆发确立为联想学习的情境敏感驱动因素。这些发现确定了丘脑皮质系统中刺激-结果关联的基于突发的神经代码，并提供了将细胞放电动力学与奖励应急学习联系起来的因果证据。

articles.title:
Electrochemically
Driven Sorbent-Mediated Recovery
of CO2 in Marine Inorganic Carbon Extraction Processes
articles.abstract: Abstract The oceans act as a sink for atmospheric CO2, absorbing more than a quarter of global emissions annually. Technologies for marine inorganic carbon dioxide removal (mCDR) have recently gained attention as a means of leveraging this effect to reduce environmental CO2 concentrations. In pH-swing mCDR systems, electrochemical acidification drives the conversion of dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) in seawater to CO2, which is then removed through vacuum stripping before the water is realkalinized and released to the ocean to draw down atmospheric carbon. While most research has focused on the pH-swing process itself, little attention has been devoted to the stripping step, which is particularly capital- and energy-intensive and indiscriminately removes dissolved oxygen, which is vital to marine life. In this work, we present a framework for an alternative sorbent-mediated CO2 concentration process, analyzing and experimentally demonstrating an electrochemically mediated embodiment. A comparative energetic and technoeconomic assessment is presented, evaluating performance relative to state-of-the-art vacuum processes and indicating that a sorbent-mediated extraction process can be a viable alternative.
articles.title_zh:
电化学
驱动吸附剂介导的回收
海洋无机碳提取过程中二氧化碳的排放
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 海洋是大气二氧化碳的汇，每年吸收全球排放量的四分之一以上。海洋无机二氧化碳去除（mCDR）技术最近作为利用这种效应降低环境二氧化碳浓度的一种手段而受到关注。在 pH 摆动 mCDR 系统中，电化学酸化驱动海水中溶解的无机碳 (DIC) 转化为 CO2，然后通过真空汽提将 CO2 去除，然后将水重新碱化并释放到海洋以吸收大气中的碳。虽然大多数研究都集中在 pH 值波动过程本身，但很少关注剥离步骤，该步骤尤其需要大量资金和能源，并且会不加区别地去除溶解氧，而溶解氧对海洋生物至关重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了替代吸附剂介导的二氧化碳浓缩过程的框架，分析并通过实验证明了电化学介导的实施方案。提出了比较能量和技术经济评估，评估了相对于最先进的真空工艺的性能，并表明吸附剂介导的萃取工艺可以是一种可行的替代方案。

articles.title:
A Potential Difference-Driven
Cascade Effect of Cathode
Biofilm–Plant Physiology Governs the Efficiency-Energy-Risk
Trade-Off in Constructed Wetland–Microbial Electrolysis Cells
articles.abstract: Abstract Conventional potential difference optimization in microbial electrolysis cell-integrated constructed wetlands (ECWs) treating antibiotic-laden wastewater frequently prioritizes single-dimensional removal efficiency, critically overlooking trade-offs with energy consumption and ecological risks. By evaluating four ECWs operated under varying potential differences treating chloramphenicol (CAP) wastewater via physicochemical metrics, multiomics, structural equation modeling, and comprehensive risk assessment, we identified a potential difference-driven “cathode biofilm–plant physiology” cascade effect governing this “efficiency-energy-risk” trade-off. Specifically, moderate potential differences (0.5 and 0.8 V) achieved superior total nitrogen (79.5–80.1%) and substantial CAP (90.9–92.5%) removal, driven by the selectively enriched electroactive, dissimilatory nitrate reduction to ammonium and CAP-degrading bacteria (e.g., Geobacter sp., Ectobacillus sp., Defluviilinea sp016789025). These microbiomes provided continuous ammonium supply, activating diverse plant nitrogen pathways and stimulating robust root radial oxygen loss to engineer a microoxic-anoxic microenvironment for comprehensive risk mitigation. Concurrently, relative to the 0.2 V control group, the 0.5 V condition minimized greenhouse gas emissions (a 49.2% reduction), lowered effluent ecotoxicity by 47.4%, and suppressed AMR risk by 56.0%, without incurring excess energy input. Ultimately, the optimal 0.5 V potential difference establishes a sustainable efficiency-energy-risk equilibrium, empowering ECWs as robust biogeochemical barriers under a unified “One Health” perspective.
articles.title_zh:
势差驱动
阴极级联效应
生物膜-植物生理学控制效率-能源-风险
人工湿地与微生物电解池的权衡
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要：微生物电解池集成人工湿地（ECW）处理富含抗生素的废水时，传统的电势差优化经常优先考虑单维去除效率，严重忽视了能源消耗和生态风险之间的权衡。通过物理化学指标、多组学、结构方程模型和综合风险评估评估在不同电位差下处理氯霉素（CAP）废水的四个 ECW，我们确定了电位差驱动的“阴极生物膜-植物生理学”级联效应，控制着这种“效率-能源-风险”的权衡。具体而言，在选择性富集的电活性、异化硝酸盐还原为铵和 CAP 降解细菌（例如，Geobacter sp.、Ectobacillus sp.、Defluviilinea sp016789025）的驱动下，中等电位差（0.5 和 0.8 V）实现了优异的总氮 (79.5–80.1%) 和大量 CAP (90.9–92.5%) 去除。这些微生物群提供持续的铵供应，激活不同的植物氮途径并刺激强劲的根部径向氧损失，以设计微氧-缺氧微环境以全面缓解风险。同时，相对于 0.2 V 对照组，0.5 V 条件最大限度地减少了温室气体排放（减少了 49.2%），将废水生态毒性降低了 47.4%，并将 AMR 风险抑制了 56.0%，且不会产生过多的能量输入。最终，最佳的 0.5 V 电位差建立了可持续的效率-能源-风险平衡，使 ECW 在统一的“One Health”视角下成为强大的生物地球化学屏障。

articles.title:
Anomalies of Net
Primary Productivity under Compound
Marine Heatwaves and Microplastics
articles.abstract: Abstract Marine heatwaves (MHW) and microplastics (MPs) pollution increasingly co-occur, yet the response of phytoplankton net primary production (NPP) to this compound condition remains incompletely characterized, in part because analyses confined to local conditions may overlook nonlocal influences. Here we developed an adaptive machine learning framework to evaluate global NPP anomalies under co-occurring MHW and MPs. The results indicate that comparable compound-stress regimes corresponded to divergent NPP outcomes depending on regional nutrient backgrounds: an anomalous increase coincided with nitrate replenishment in oligotrophic waters, whereas an anomalous decrease coincided with silicate accumulation in iron-limited, diatom-dominated waters. Furthermore, pronounced NPP anomalies frequently exhibited a geographic offset from heatwave cores, a spatial mismatch consistent with a shock-transmission-spillover (STS) framework, here interpreted as a spatial teleconnection between the thermal forcing and the ecological response. Pending in situ validation, these observed associations indicate that monitoring confined to thermal or pollution sources may misplace ecological risk. Consequently, these findings support a shift toward downstream monitoring along current pathways relevant to fisheries and carbon uptake.
articles.title_zh:
网络异常
复合条件下的初级生产力
海洋热浪和微塑料
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 海洋热浪（MHW）和微塑料（MP）污染日益同时发生，但浮游植物净初级生产力（NPP）对这种复合条件的响应仍未完全表征，部分原因是仅限于局部条件的分析可能会忽视非局部影响。在这里，我们开发了一个自适应机器学习框架来评估同时发生的 MHW 和 MP 下的全球 NPP 异常。结果表明，根据区域营养背景，可比较的复合胁迫状况对应于不同的NPP结果：异常增加与寡营养水域中硝酸盐的补充同时发生，而异常减少与铁有限、硅藻为主的水域中硅酸盐的积累同时发生。此外，明显的NPP异常经常表现出与热浪核心的地理偏移，这是一种与冲击-传递-溢出（STS）框架一致的空间失配，这里解释为热强迫与生态响应之间的空间遥相关。在现场验证之前，这些观察到的关联表明，仅限于热源或污染源的监测可能会错失生态风险。因此，这些发现支持沿着当前与渔业和碳吸收相关的途径转向下游监测。

articles.title:
Correction
to “Disaster Preparedness and Perceptions
of People who Experienced Water Insecurity: Insights from the Lloyd’s
Register Foundation’s World Risk Poll”
articles.abstract: Abstract Water insecurity refers to lacking stable access to enough safe water for drinking and domestic use. To understand the communication needs of individuals who have experienced water insecurity, we analyzed World Risk Poll data from over 125,000 participants across 121 countries. We present three key findings. First, having experienced water insecurity was associated with lower perceived disaster preparedness. Second, participants who had experienced water insecurity trusted disaster information providers slightly less, though local media and emergency services were highly trusted. Third, worry about water safety was more strongly correlated with worry about severe weather than with worry about climate change, especially among individuals who had experienced water insecurity. Therefore, individuals who have experienced water insecurity may benefit from communications that improve disaster preparedness, leverage local media and emergency services, and emphasize threats of severe weather to water safety.
articles.title_zh:

articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 水不安全是指无法稳定获得足够的安全水用于饮用水和家庭用水。为了了解经历过水不安全的个人的沟通需求，我们分析了来自 121 个国家/地区超过 125,000 名参与者的世界风险民意调查数据。我们提出了三个主要发现。首先，经历过水不安全与较低的备灾意识有关。其次，经历过水不安全的参与者对灾害信息提供者的信任度稍低，尽管当地媒体和紧急服务机构高度信任。第三，对水安全的担忧与对恶劣天气的担忧比对气候变化的担忧更密切相关，特别是对于那些经历过水不安全的人来说。因此，经历过水不安全的个人可能会受益于改善备灾、利用当地媒体和应急服务以及强调恶劣天气对水安全的威胁的通信。

articles.title: Synergistic effect of paired Cu(II) open metal sites for enhanced high-temperature hydrogen isotope separation
articles.abstract: Abstract The selective separation of hydrogen isotopes under mild cryogenic conditions remains a formidable challenge due to their nearly identical physicochemical properties. Here, we report a dual strategy of pore topology design and paired Cu(II) open metal sites (OMS) synergistic engineering to amplify chemical affinity quantum sieving (CAQS). Among three tailored Cu(II)-MOFs, Cu-ATC exhibited exceptional performance, achieving a D 2 /H 2 selectivity of 20 at 50 K (10 mbar) and 1.8 in breakthrough experiments at 77 K, demonstrating excellent H 2 /D 2 separation performance. The ultramicroporous topology of Cu-ATC fixes a Cu···Cu distance of 5.98 Å within one-dimensional channels, while Jahn–Teller distortion induces axial elongation at each Cu(II) center, thereby enhancing the accessibility of the d z 2 orbitals for interaction with hydrogen isotope molecules. This structural combination creates two closely spaced OMSs that enhance differential interactions with H 2 and D 2 , thereby driving isotope separation via CAQS. The distinct binding strength is evidenced by in situ DRIFTS (v(H-H)/ v(D-D) red-shift of 203 cm −1 / 147 cm −1 ) and by DFT calculations showing stronger adsorption of H 2 ( − 9.7 kJ mol −1 ) and D 2 ( − 13.0 kJ mol −1 ). These microscopic differences account for the observed D 2 /H 2 selectivity, highlighting the potential of paired OMSs engineering for CAQS-based isotope separation under mild cryogenic conditions.
articles.title_zh: 成对的 Cu(II) 开放金属位点对增强高温氢同位素分离的协同作用
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 由于氢同位素几乎相同的物理化学性质，在温和低温条件下选择性分离氢同位素仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。在这里，我们报告了孔拓扑设计和配对 Cu(II) 开放金属位点 (OMS) 协同工程的双重策略，以放大化学亲和量子筛分 (CAQS)。在三种定制的Cu(II)-MOF中，Cu-ATC表现出优异的性能，在50 K (10 mbar)下实现了20的D 2 /H 2 选择性，在77 K下的突破性实验中实现了1.8，表现出优异的H 2 /D 2 分离性能。 Cu-ATC 的超微孔拓扑在一维通道内固定了 5.98 Å 的 Cu·Cu 距离，而 Jahn-Teller 畸变会诱导每个 Cu(II) 中心的轴向伸长，从而增强 d z 2 轨道与氢同位素分子相互作用的可及性。这种结构组合产生了两个紧密间隔的 OMS，增强了与 H 2 和 D 2 的差异相互作用，从而通过 CAQS 驱动同位素分离。原位漂移（v(H-H)/ v(D-D) 红移 203 cm -1 / 147 cm -1 ）和 DFT 计算证明了独特的结合强度，显示 H 2 ( - 9.7 kJ mol -1 ) 和 D 2 ( - 13.0 kJ mol -1 ) 具有更强的吸附作用。这些微观差异解释了观察到的 D 2 /H 2 选择性，突出了配对 OMS 工程在温和低温条件下基于 CAQS 的同位素分离的潜力。

articles.title: Suppression of transcription-replication conflicts by sequence-coordinated actions of TRDMT1 and MutLα
articles.abstract: Abstract TRDMT1 is an RNA methyltransferase that catalyzes 5-methylcytosine (m5C) formation in R-loops to promote transcription-coupled homologous recombination (TC-HR). Although TRDMT1 inhibition selectively kills BRCA1-deficient cancer cells, broader cancer dependencies on TRDMT1 remain unclear. Here, a TRDMT1 inhibitor (TRDMT1i) sensitivity screen across a large panel of cancer cell lines identifies loss of MLH1 or PMS2, two components of the MutLα mismatch repair (MMR) complex frequently inactivated in tumors, as key determinants of TRDMT1 dependency. In contrast, MutLβ and MutSα/β are dispensable for TRDMT1i resistance, revealing a unique MMR-independent function of MutLα. Mechanistically, TRDMT1 and MutLα independently recognize DNA–RNA hybrids and cooperatively suppress co-transcriptional R-loops genome-wide in undamaged cells, with m5C directing pathway choice. Furthermore, MutLα suppresses R-loops through its ATPase and endonuclease activities and through recruitment of EXO1. Combined loss of TRDMT1 and MLH1 causes extensive R-loop accumulation and transcription replication conflicts (TRCs), impairing replication fork progression, inducing DNA damage, and driving apoptosis-mediated synthetic lethality. Importantly, TRDMT1i suppresses growth of MLH1-deficient tumors by inducing TRCs in vivo, suggesting a potential therapeutic strategy for targeting MutLα-deficient tumors. These studies not only expand our understanding of cancer dependency on TRDMT1, but also identify a promising strategy to exploit TRCs in cancer therapy.
articles.title_zh: TRDMT1 和 MutLα 的序列协调作用抑制转录复制冲突
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 TRDMT1 是一种 RNA 甲基转移酶，可催化 R 环中 5-甲基胞嘧啶 (m5C) 的形成，从而促进转录偶联同源重组 (TC-HR)。尽管 TRDMT1 抑制选择性杀死 BRCA1 缺陷的癌细胞，但更广泛的癌症对 TRDMT1 的依赖性仍不清楚。在这里，对大量癌细胞系进行的 TRDMT1 抑制剂 (TRDMT1i) 敏感性筛选发现了 MLH1 或 PMS2 的丢失，这两种成分是肿瘤中经常失活的 MutLα 错配修复 (MMR) 复合物，是 TRDMT1 依赖性的关键决定因素。相比之下，MutLβ 和 MutSα/β 对于 TRDMT1i 抗性来说是可有可无的，这揭示了 MutLα 独特的独立于 MMR 的功能。从机制上讲，TRDMT1 和 MutLα 独立识别 DNA-RNA 杂合体，并在 m5C 指导通路选择的情况下，协同抑制未受损细胞中全基因组的共转录 R 环。此外，MutLα 通过其 ATP 酶和核酸内切酶活性以及通过招募 EXO1 来抑制 R 环。 TRDMT1 和 MLH1 的联合缺失会导致广泛的 R 环积累和转录复制冲突 (TRC)，损害复制叉进展，诱导 DNA 损伤，并驱动细胞凋亡介导的合成致死。重要的是，TRDMT1i 通过在体内诱导 TRC 来抑制 MLH1 缺陷型肿瘤的生长，这表明了一种针对 MutLα 缺陷型肿瘤的潜在治疗策略。这些研究不仅扩大了我们对 TRDMT1 癌症依赖性的理解，而且还确定了在癌症治疗中利用 TRC 的有前途的策略。

articles.title:
An Initial Assessment
of Microplastic Distribution
across Trophic Levels in Benthic Ecosystems of Tidal Flats
articles.abstract: Abstract Microplastics (MPs) are widespread pollutants, yet their distribution across the trophic levels in tidal flat ecosystems remain poorly understood. We investigated MPs in sediments, seawater, macroalgae, and benthic organisms (19 species, 81 individuals) from two tidal flats in Incheon, Republic of Korea using a count-based approach. MPs were dominated by polypropylene, polyethylene, and polystyrene, with 20–100 μm particles accounting for 65% of total particles. Abundance ranged from 0.85 to 2.72 MPs/g dw in sediments and 0.4–2.2 MPs/L in seawater. Predators (3.63 ± 1.44 MPs/g) contained higher MP levels than their prey, filter feeders (0.87 ± 0.63 MPs/g), while detritivores (26.69 ± 31.45 MPs/g) exhibited higher abundances than macroalgae (11.62 ± 8.37 MPs/g). Deposit feeders accumulated significantly more MPs than filter feeders, reflecting feeding strategy-dependent exposure pathways. Bioconcentration factors (BCF > 1), bioaccumulation factors (BAF > 1), and predator-prey biomagnification factors ranging from 3.9 to 9.6 were observed based on particle counts. Despite lower MP abundance, filter feeders exhibited higher potential polymer-associated hazards, suggesting that MP abundance alone does not fully represent ecological risk. These findings highlight the importance of feeding ecology in shaping MP exposure and accumulation in tidal flats.
articles.title_zh:
初步评估
微塑料分布
滩涂底栖生态系统的营养级
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 微塑料（MP）是一种广泛存在的污染物，但人们对其在滩涂生态系统营养级中的分布仍知之甚少。我们使用基于计数的方法调查了韩国仁川两个滩涂的沉积物、海水、大型藻类和底栖生物（19 个物种，81 个个体）中的 MP。 MPs以聚丙烯、聚乙烯和聚苯乙烯为主，20~100μm颗粒占总颗粒数的65%。沉积物中的丰度范围为 0.85 至 2.72 MPs/g 干重，海水中的丰度范围为 0.4-2.2 MPs/L。捕食者 (3.63 ± 1.44 MPs/g) 的 MP 水平高于猎物、滤食性动物 (0.87 ± 0.63 MPs/g)，而食碎屑动物 (26.69 ± 31.45 MPs/g) 的丰度高于大型藻类 (11.62 ± 8.37 MPs/g)。沉积饲养动物比滤食动物积累了更多的 MP，反映了饲养策略依赖的暴露途径。基于颗粒计数观察到生物浓缩因子(BCF>1)、生物累积因子(BAF>1)和捕食者-猎物生物放大因子范围为3.9至9.6。尽管 MP 丰度较低，但滤食性动物表现出较高的潜在聚合物相关危害，表明 MP 丰度本身并不能完全代表生态风险。这些发现强调了摄食生态对于影响滩涂 MP 暴露和积累的重要性。

articles.title:
Linear Alkylbenzenesulfonates
in Polyurethane Soft
Foam Products Drive Toxic Responses in Early Life Stage Fish
articles.abstract: Abstract Polyurethane soft foam (PSF), one of the most extensively used plastics in household products, presents both convenience and disposal challenges. The chemical makeup of PSF, particularly its released substances, remains unclear, as do the drivers of toxicity to aquatic organisms. Here, zebrafish (Danio rerio) were used as a model to evaluate the potential adverse effects of 47 PSF and similar-use products through swimming behavior and metabolomic profiling, and to identify the key toxic chemicals leached from these products by means of liquid chromatography coupled with high-resolution mass spectrometry and correlation analysis. Among these, PSF leachates showed more severe adverse effects on larvae compared to latex and silicone leachates, with a higher number of chemical features and greater total abundance. Notably, linear alkylbenzenesulfonates (LAS), which accounted for nearly half of the chemicals significantly associated with toxicity, were predominantly found in PSF products. The concentrations of LAS in these products ranged from 5.6 to 4078.9 μg/g, with an average of 1015.6 μg/g. Of these, p-(3-dodecyl)benzenesulfonic acid was selected as the representative driver of LAS toxicity, which induced consistent behavioral and metabolic disruption in zebrafish similar to the effects observed with PSF leachates. This work suggests that LAS are potential adverse chemicals in PSF products and that their continued, widespread use raises concern for aquatic ecosystems.
articles.title_zh:
直链烷基苯磺酸盐
聚氨酯软质
泡沫产品会导致鱼类生命早期的毒性反应
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 聚氨酯软泡沫（PSF）是家用产品中使用最广泛的塑料之一，在便利性和处置方面都面临挑战。 PSF 的化学成分，特别是其释放的物质，以及对水生生物的毒性驱动因素仍不清楚。在这里，以斑马鱼（Danio rerio）为模型，通过游泳行为和代谢组学分析评估 47 PSF 和类似用途产品的潜在不利影响，并通过液相色谱结合高分辨率质谱和相关分析来鉴定从这些产品中浸出的关键有毒化学物质。其中，与乳胶和有机硅渗滤液相比，PSF渗滤液对幼虫表现出更严重的不利影响，具有更多的化学特征和更大的总丰度。值得注意的是，直链烷基苯磺酸盐 (LAS) 占与毒性显着相关的化学物质的近一半，主要存在于 PSF 产品中。这些产品中LAS的浓度范围为5.6至4078.9μg/g，平均值为1015.6μg/g。其中，对（3-十二烷基）苯磺酸被选为 LAS 毒性的代表性驱动因素，它会诱导斑马鱼出现一致的行为和代谢破坏，类似于 PSF 渗滤液观察到的效果。这项工作表明，LAS 是 PSF 产品中潜在的不利化学物质，其持续、广泛使用引起了对水生生态系统的担忧。

articles.title: Ultraviolet Radiation Enhances the Toxicity of Tire Wear Particle Leachate to Early Life Stages of Red Drum ( Sciaenops ocellatus ) & Southern Flounder ( Paralichthys lethostigma )
articles.abstract: Abstract Tire wear particles (TWP) that runoff into aquatic habitats are linked to fish kills in urbanized watersheds of the Pacific Northwest. These TWP leach complex chemical mixtures, including photodynamic compounds that can become orders of magnitude more toxic under solar radiation. This enhancement is especially relevant for transparent aquatic organisms in high-solar environments, such as Gulf of Mexico (GoM) estuaries that provide critical nursery habitats for recreationally and ecologically valuable early life stage (ELS) fishes. Yet data on TWP contamination and photoinduced toxicity in these systems remain limited. Using a fully factorial design, we exposed ELS red drum (Sciaenops ocellatus) and southern flounder (Paralichthys lethostigma) to TWP leachate under ambient indoor lighting or simulated solar radiation (as UV-A). Sensitivity was species-specific and dependent on UV coexposure. Red drum mortality increased independently with dose and UV, while southern flounder were sensitive regardless of UV. Sublethal impacts were mixed: red drum showed reduced growth, altered energy utilization, and diminished development under UV, whereas southern flounder showed reduced size and significant pericardial edema regardless of UV. These results demonstrate that TWP toxicity is species-specific and mediated by both phototoxic and nonphototoxic mechanisms, highlighting the vulnerability of ELS fishes in critical nursery habitats.
articles.title_zh: 紫外线 辐射 增强轮胎的毒性 磨损颗粒渗滤液至红鼓生命早期阶段（ 眼斑石首鱼 ) &南方比目鱼（ 牙鲆 ）
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 流入水生栖息地的轮胎磨损颗粒（TWP）与太平洋西北部城市化流域的鱼类死亡有关。这些 TWP 会浸出复杂的化学混合物，包括光动力化合物，这些化合物在太阳辐射下的毒性可能会增加几个数量级。这种增强对于高太阳环境中的透明水生生物尤其重要，例如墨西哥湾（GoM）河口，为具有娱乐性和生态价值的早期生命阶段（ELS）鱼类提供重要的繁殖栖息地。然而，有关这些系统中 TWP 污染和光致毒性的数据仍然有限。采用全因子设计，我们将 ELS 红石首鱼 (Sciaenops ocellatus) 和南方比目鱼 (Paralichthys lethostigma) 在室内环境照明或模拟太阳辐射（如 UV-A）下暴露于 TWP 渗滤液中。灵敏度因物种而异，并且取决于紫外线共曝光。红拟石首鱼死亡率随剂量和紫外线的变化而独立增加，而南方比目鱼则对紫外线敏感。亚致死影响是复杂的：红石首鱼在紫外线下表现出生长减慢、能量利用改变和发育减弱，而南方比目鱼则表现出体型缩小和明显的心包水肿，无论紫外线如何。这些结果表明，TWP 毒性具有物种特异性，并由光毒性和非光毒性机制介导，凸显了 ELS 鱼类在关键苗圃栖息地的脆弱性。

articles.title:
Redox Alternation
Drives Dynamics of Sediment Reducing
Capacity: Dominance of Reducing Organic Substances and Ferrous-Iron/Sulfur
Synergistic Mechanisms
articles.abstract: Abstract Sediment reducing capacity (RC) regulates benthic habitat function and the biogeochemical cycling of carbon, nutrients, and pollutants. However, the compositional complexity and dynamic responses of RC to redox alternation remain inadequately characterized. Through laboratory stimulation experiments of redox alternation with 20 freshwater sediments from four water bodies with distinct trophic status in China (Honghu Lake: HL, n = 3; Xiashan Reservoir: XR, n = 6; Yudong Reservoir: YR, n = 7; and Zhanghe Reservoir: ZR, n = 4), we monitored the dynamics of RC and its fractions (RCpH7.0, RCpH2.0), and quantified the responses of major reducing components (reducing organic substances (RedOr), Fe(II), and sulfides (Sn, −2 ≤ n < 0)). Redox alternation triggered asynchronous RC responses, with depletion during oxic phases and recovery under anoxia. RC fluctuation amplitude exhibited sediment-type dependence, with RedOr-Sn sediments (HL/XR) showing greater variability than RedOr-Fe(II) systems (YR/ZR). Component-specific contributions differed significantly between sediment types (p < 0.05). RedOr contributed most to RC variation in RedOr-Sn sediments (45.9–71.2% vs 35.7–52.2% in RedOr-Fe(II)), whereas Fe(II) contributed 45.8–61.5% in RedOr-Fe(II) sediments (18.9–26.6% in RedOr-Sn), and Sn accounted for 8.73–27.5% in RedOr-Sn sediments (1.62–2.62% in RedOr-Fe(II)). These differences reflected anoxia-driven differences in component reactivity and abundance. RedOr-Sn sediments exhibited concurrent enrichment of RedOr, Fe(II), and Sn, whereas RedOr-Fe(II) sediments showed mainly enhanced Fe(II) reactivity with limited RedOr/Sn changes. Mechanistically, the observed RC patterns were consistent with distinct Fe cycling pathways. In RedOr-Sn sediments, limited labile Fe(III) was associated with greater apparent involvement of magnetite, whereas easily reducible/reducible Fe(III) fractions were more prominent in RedOr-Fe(II) systems. Our findings demonstrate the high lability of eutrophic sediment RC and establish redox alternation as an efficient diagnostic tool for identifying reductive sediment types and pinpointing regulatory targets.
articles.title_zh:
氧化还原交替
推动减沙动力
能力：还原有机物和二价铁/硫为主
协同机制
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 减沙能力（RC）调节底栖栖息地功能以及碳、养分和污染物的生物地球化学循环。然而，RC 的组成复杂性和氧化还原交替的动态响应仍然没有得到充分的表征。通过对中国四个具有不同营养状态的水体（洪湖：HL，n = 3；霞山水库：XR，n = 6；鱼洞水库：YR，n = 7；漳河水库：ZR，n = 4）的20个淡水沉积物进行氧化还原交替实验室刺激实验，我们监测了RC及其组分（RCpH7.0、RCpH2.0）的动态变化，量化了主要还原成分（还原有机物质（RedOr）、Fe（II）和硫化物（Sn，-2 ≤ n < 0））的响应。氧化还原交替触发异步 RC 响应，在有氧阶段耗尽，在缺氧阶段恢复。 RC 波动幅度表现出沉积物类型依赖性，RedOr-Sn 沉积物 (HL/XR) 表现出比 RedOr-Fe(II) 系统 (YR/ZR) 更大的变异性。沉积物类型之间特定成分的贡献存在显着差异（p < 0.05）。 RedOr 对 RedOr-Sn 沉积物中 RC 变化的贡献最大（45.9–71.2% vs RedOr-Fe(II) 中的 35.7–52.2%），而 Fe(II) 在 RedOr-Fe(II) 沉积物中贡献 45.8–61.5%（RedOr-Sn 中 18.9–26.6%），Sn 在 RedOr-Sn 中占 8.73–27.5%沉积物（RedOr-Fe(II) 中 1.62–2.62%）。这些差异反映了缺氧驱动的组分反应性和丰度差异。 RedOr-Sn沉积物表现出同时富集RedOr、Fe(II)和Sn，而RedOr-Fe(II)沉积物主要表现出Fe(II)反应性增强，而RedOr/Sn变化有限。从机制上讲，观察到的 RC 模式与不同的铁循环途径一致。在 RedOr-Sn 沉积物中，有限的不稳定 Fe(III) 与磁铁矿的明显参与有关，而易还原/可还原的 Fe(III) 部分在 RedOr-Fe(II) 系统中更为突出。我们的研究结果证明了富营养化沉积物 RC 的高度不稳定性，并将氧化还原交替确立为一种有效的诊断工具，用于识别还原性沉积物类型和精确定位监管目标。

articles.title: An OsWRKY1– OsPht1;4 Regulatory Module Restricts Arsenic Uptake and Accumulation in Rice Grain
articles.abstract: Abstract Arsenic (As) contamination in paddy soils poses a threat to human health through rice consumption. Arsenate (AsV) uptake contributes to grain As accumulation, yet its upstream regulatory mechanisms remain largely unknown. Here, we identified a WRKY transcription factor, OsWRKY1, as a key regulator of AsV uptake in rice plant, whose expression is strongly induced by AsV at both transcript and protein levels. Loss of OsWRKY1 function increased rice root As concentration by 2.8-fold under hydroponic conditions and raised grain As concentration by 19–22% in soil-grown plants compared with wild type, indicating that OsWRKY1 is a negative regulator of As accumulation. Chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing revealed that OsWRKY1 directly binds to the promoter of P-transporter OsPht1;4, an also major AsV transporter gene in rice, but not to other Pht1 family members. Dual-luciferase assays further showed that OsWRKY1 represses OsPht1;4 promoter activity. Under AsV exposure, OsPht1;4 transcript levels were upregulated by 2.5-fold in oswrky1 mutants and were downregulated by 90% compared with wild type in OsWRKY1-overexpressing lines. These results define the OsWRKY1–OsPht1;4 module as a critical transcriptional repression mechanism that limits AsV uptake and accumulation in rice grain, providing a mechanistic basis for restricting As accumulation through specific transcriptional regulation of AsV uptake.
articles.title_zh: OsWRKY1– OsPht1;4 监管 模块限制稻谷中砷的吸收和积累
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 稻田土壤砷（As）污染通过稻米消费对人类健康构成威胁。砷酸盐（AsV）的吸收有助于谷物砷的积累，但其上游调节机制仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，我们鉴定了 WRKY 转录因子 OsWRKY1，它是水稻植物中 AsV 摄取的关键调节因子，其表达在转录本和蛋白质水平上均受到 AsV 的强烈诱导。与野生型相比，OsWRKY1 功能丧失使水培条件下水稻根部 As 浓度增加了 2.8 倍，土壤种植植物的籽粒 As 浓度增加了 19-22%，表明 OsWRKY1 是 As 积累的负调节因子。染色质免疫沉淀测序显示，OsWRKY1 直接与 P 转运蛋白 OsPht1;4 的启动子结合，OsPht1;4 也是水稻中主要的 AsV 转运蛋白基因，但不与其他 Pht1 家族成员结合。双荧光素酶测定进一步表明 OsWRKY1 抑制 OsPht1;4 启动子活性。在 AsV 暴露下，oswrky1 突变体中 OsPht1;4 转录水平上调 2.5 倍，与 OsWRKY1 过表达株系中的野生型相比下调 90%。这些结果将OsWRKY1–OsPht1;4模块定义为限制AsV摄取和积累的关键转录抑制机制，为通过AsV摄取的特异性转录调控来限制As积累提供了机制基础。

articles.title:
Nitrogen-Rich
Pyrogenic Carbon-Induced Hydroxyl Radical
Generation During Sulfide Oxidation: An Unrecognized Polysulfide Radical
Chain Propagation Mechanism
articles.abstract: Abstract Sulfide oxidation mediated by pyrogenic carbon (PyC) is critical for initiating reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation in subsurface systems. Nitrogen-rich pyrogenic carbon (N-PyC), containing abundant heterocyclic N, serves as a highly reactive component of the PyC pool; yet, its role in regulating sulfide oxidation remains unclear. The study systematically investigated the overlooked role of N-PyC in dark •OH generation during sulfide oxidation. Compared to counterpart PyC, N-PyC significantly increased •OH production during sulfide oxidation by ∼2–3 times, elevating pollutant degradation efficiencies in soils by >50%. Spectroscopic and electron paramagnetic resonance analyses revealed a novel electron transfer pathway mediated by N-PyC, which effectively facilitated the formation and subsequent propagation of polysulfide radicals. Unlike the previously reported two-electron transfer mechanisms on conductive graphitic domains, these polysulfide radicals induced by N-PyC enhanced •OH generation by >80% via a single-electron transfer mechanism with oxygen, as evidenced by electrochemical results. Theoretical calculations demonstrated that pyridinic N thermodynamically promoted the binding and homolytic cleavage of reactive sulfur structures by 0.7 and 0.13 eV, respectively, thereby activating polysulfide radicals. Soil incubations confirmed a significant positive correlation between N-PyC-mediated sulfide oxidation and •OH production in natural sulfide-rich zones (R2 = 0.87, p < 0.01). This study reveals a polysulfide radical-mediated electron transfer pathway for •OH formation, offering insights into the biogeochemical processes of sulfide oxidation and the involved ROS dynamics in pyrogenic-impacted environments.
articles.title_zh:
富氮
热解碳诱导的羟基自由基
硫化物氧化过程中的生成：一种未被识别的多硫化物自由基
链式传播机制
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 热解碳 (PyC) 介导的硫化物氧化对于启动地下系统中活性氧 (ROS) 的产生至关重要。富氮热解碳（N-PyC）含有丰富的杂环氮，是 PyC 库的高活性成分；然而，其在调节硫化物氧化中的作用仍不清楚。该研究系统地研究了 N-PyC 在硫化物氧化过程中暗·OH 生成中被忽视的作用。与对应的PyC相比，N-PyC在硫化物氧化过程中显着增加了·OH的产生~2-3倍，将土壤中的污染物降解效率提高了>50%。光谱和电子顺磁共振分析揭示了一种由 N-PyC 介导的新型电子转移途径，该途径有效促进了多硫化物自由基的形成和随后的传播。与之前报道的导电石墨域上的双电子转移机制不同，N-PyC诱导的这些多硫化物自由基通过与氧的单电子转移机制将·OH的生成增强了＞80％，如电化学结果所证明的。理论计算表明，吡啶N在热力学上分别促进活性硫结构的结合和均裂裂解0.7和0.13 eV，从而激活多硫自由基。土壤培养证实了N-PyC 介导的硫化物氧化与天然富含硫化物区域•OH 的产生之间存在显着的正相关性（R2 = 0.87，p < 0.01）。这项研究揭示了多硫自由基介导的·OH 形成电子转移途径，为了解硫化物氧化的生物地球化学过程以及受热解影响的环境中所涉及的活性氧动力学提供了见解。

articles.title:
Seasonal
and Habitat-Specific Mercury Cycling in Coastal
Biota Revealed by Species-Specific Isotopes
articles.abstract: Abstract Understanding how inorganic mercury (IHg, primarily Hg(II)) and methylmercury (MeHg, primarily monomethylmercury) transform and cycle in coastal food webs is essential for evaluating Hg exposure risks, yet relevant species-specific mercury (Hg) isotope studies remain scarce. Here, we optimized a purge-trap method that enabled efficient separation and isotopic analysis of IHg and MeHg in marine organisms. Applying this method to surface and benthic organisms collected from the Bohai Sea in winter and summer, we reveal distinct seasonal and habitat-specific Hg dynamics. Surface organisms primarily accumulated MeHg that had undergone photodemethylation in the water column, while benthic organisms assimilated a mixture of photodegraded water-column MeHg (64–80%) and nonphotodegraded MeHg produced in sediments (20–36%). In vivo MeHg demethylation was substantially enhanced in surface organisms during summer, contributing ∼36% of the organismal IHg pool. Species-specific isotope signatures further suggest that methylation of IHg in sediments is a major source of MeHg to the water column, with ∼14–19% of it being photodegraded before biological uptake. Together, these findings provide new mechanistic insight into coastal Hg cycling and advance the isotopic framework for assessing ecological risks associated with marine Hg exposure.
articles.title_zh:
季节性
和沿海特定栖息地的汞循环
物种特异性同位素揭示的生物群
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 了解无机汞（IHg，主要是 Hg(II)）和甲基汞（MeHg，主要是单甲基汞）如何在沿海食物网中转化和循环对于评估汞暴露风险至关重要，但相关的物种特异性汞 (Hg) 同位素研究仍然很少。在这里，我们优化了一种净化捕集方法，能够对海洋生物中的 IHg 和 MeHg 进行有效的分离和同位素分析。将这种方法应用于冬季和夏季从渤海收集的表层和底栖生物，我们揭示了不同的季节性和特定栖息地的汞动态。地表生物主要积累在水柱中经过光脱甲基化的甲基汞，而底栖生物则吸收光降解水柱甲基汞（64-80%）和沉积物中产生的非光降解甲基汞（20-36%）的混合物。夏季，表面生物体内甲基汞去甲基化显着增强，占生物体内甲基汞库的 36%。物种特异性同位素特征进一步表明，沉积物中 IHg 的甲基化是水柱中 MeHg 的主要来源，其中约 14-19% 在生物吸收之前被光降解。总之，这些发现为沿海汞循环提供了新的机制见解，并推进了评估与海洋汞暴露相关的生态风险的同位素框架。

articles.title:
Multi-technology
Detection of Undocumented Orphaned
Oil and Gas Wells: A Large-Scale Drone and Ground-Based Survey in
Pennsylvania
articles.abstract: Abstract Hundreds of thousands of undocumented orphaned oil and gas wells are estimated to exist in the United States. These wells have no formal owner, and their locations and conditions are unknown. They pose risks to the environment, climate, human health, and safety, and they represent a potential source of methane. While drone-based magnetometry and methane surveys have been used for well detection, no study has systematically integrated these technologies with ground-based methods, multi-stakeholder coordination, and field verification into a single framework at this scale. We conducted a drone-based magnetometry survey over 12 km2 of hilly, forested terrain in Northwest Pennsylvania and identified 31 undocumented wells by regulator-led field verification, with methane emissions detected at three of the 31 wells. Several drone-identified magnetic anomalies (13%, n = 34) were revisited using ground-based magnetometers, indicating the potential presence of 15 buried undocumented wells. However, since the interpretation of both drone- and ground-based magnetometry relies on expert judgment, field verification remains necessary. The drone-based methane sensor detected elevated methane concentrations over forested areas, but emission sources could not be confidently attributed. This study presents the largest drone-based survey of its kind and introduces a multi-technology framework that integrates drone and ground-based magnetometry and methane measurements, along with regulator-led field verification, for systematically locating and evaluating undocumented orphaned wells in complex terrain.
articles.title_zh:
多技术
检测无证孤儿
石油和天然气井：大规模无人机和地面勘测
宾夕法尼亚州
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 美国估计存在数十万个无证孤儿油气井。这些井没有正式的所有者，其位置和条件也不得而知。它们对环境、气候、人类健康和安全构成风险，并且是潜在的甲烷来源。虽然基于无人机的磁力测量和甲烷勘测已用于油井探测，但还没有研究将这些技术与地面方法、多利益相关者协调和现场验证系统地集成到如此规模的单一框架中。我们对宾夕法尼亚州西北部 12 平方公里的丘陵森林地形进行了基于无人机的磁力测量，并通过监管机构主导的现场核查确定了 31 口无证井，其中 31 口井中的 3 口检测到了甲烷排放。使用地面磁力计重新审视了几个无人机识别的磁异常（13%，n = 34），表明可能存在 15 个未记录的地下井。然而，由于无人机和地面磁力测量的解释都依赖于专家判断，因此现场验证仍然是必要的。基于无人机的甲烷传感器检测到森林地区甲烷浓度升高，但无法确定排放源。这项研究提出了同类中最大的基于无人机的调查，并引入了一个多技术框架，该框架集成了无人机和地面磁力测量和甲烷测量，以及监管机构主导的现场验证，用于系统地定位和评估复杂地形中无证孤井。

articles.title:
Ozone-Assisted Swelling-Fixation
of Sulfur-Containing
VOCs: A Room-Temperature Strategy for High-Capacity Sulfur Fixation
articles.abstract: Abstract Malodorous sulfur-containing volatile organic compounds (SVOCs) pose severe environmental and health risks, while existing physical or chemical abatement technologies suffer from low efficiency and poor economic viability. Herein, a low concentration ozone-assisted swelling-fixation of SVOCs (OSS) strategy is proposed using YMn2O5 mullite as a sulfur-fixing material, with CH3SH as a model pollutant. A sulfur fixation capacity of 1344.2 wt % (13.4× the YMO mass) is achieved and validated in a prototype device. Combined experimental characterizations and theoretical simulations reveal that ozone-derived reactive oxygen species synergize with Mn–Mn dimers, enable the thermodynamically and kinetically favorable conversion of CH3SH into liquid CH3SO2SCH3 and solid Mn(CH3SO3)2/SO42– products. The accumulation of these products builds a swollen surface layer on YMn2O5 that remains reactive toward CH3SH/O3 and allows continued sulfur fixation. Life-cycle assessment reveals a favorable trend in reducing carbon emissions, pollutant emissions, and eco-costs compared with conventional adsorption and oxidation routes. This room-temperature strategy enables scalable and sustainable SVOCs abatement, odor control, and sulfur resource fixation.
articles.title_zh:
臭氧辅助肿胀固定
含硫量
VOC：高容量固硫的室温策略
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 恶臭的含硫挥发性有机化合物（SVOC）造成严重的环境和健康风险，而现有的物理或化学减排技术效率低且经济可行性差。本文以YMn2O5莫来石为固硫材料，以CH3SH为模型污染物，提出了低浓度臭氧辅助溶胀固定SVOCs（OSS）策略。在原型装置中实现并验证了 1344.2 wt%（13.4× YMO 质量）的固硫能力。结合实验表征和理论模拟表明，臭氧衍生的活性氧与 Mn-Mn 二聚体协同作用，使 CH3SH 在热力学和动力学上有利地转化为液体 CH3SO2SCH3 和固体 Mn(CH3SO3)2/SO42– 产物。这些产物的积累在 YMn2O5 上形成了一个膨胀的表面层，该表面层对 CH3SH/O3 保持反应性，并允许持续的硫固定。生命周期评估揭示了与传统吸附和氧化路线相比，在减少碳排放、污染物排放和生态成本方面的有利趋势。这种室温策略可实现可扩展且可持续的 SVOC 减排、气味控制和硫资源固定。

Correction
to “PFAS Toxicity: What’s
True, What’s Not, and What Really Matters”

articles.title:
Commercial
Fleet
Electrification for More Equitable
Air Quality, Health, and Climate Benefits
articles.abstract: Abstract Electric vehicles (EVs) are central to low-carbon transportation, yet research has predominantly focused on passenger vehicles, leaving the climate, air quality, and equity implications of commercial fleet electrification underexplored. Here, we quantify the climate and health impacts of electrifying different vehicle fleets by integrating fleet projections, hybrid life-cycle assessment, and air quality modeling for 367 Chinese cities in 2023 and 2030. Although commercial EVs (electric trucks and public fleets) account for less than 10% of China’s EV stock, they deliver 48% of climate benefits and 60% of health benefits in 2023, increasing to 52% and 71% by 2030, with electric trucks driving most future gains. While electric trucks are not yet climate-beneficial in some coal-intensive regions, ongoing grid decarbonization will address the climate concern soon nationwide. By 2030, the poorest 50% of the population will receive only 33% of health benefits from passenger EV adoption, but nearly half (47%) from electrifying trucks and public fleets. Unlike the uneven, income-biased health benefits from passenger EVs, electrifying commercial fleets yields dominant and more equitable gains, highlighting it as an efficient and just pathway toward low-carbon mobility.
articles.title_zh:
商业
舰队
电气化促进更公平
空气质量、健康和气候效益
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 电动汽车 (EV) 是低碳交通的核心，但研究主要集中在乘用车上，而商业车队电气化对气候、空气质量和公平性的影响尚未得到充分探讨。在此，我们通过整合 2023 年和 2030 年中国 367 个城市的车队预测、混合生命周期评估和空气质量模型，量化了不同车队电动化对气候和健康的影响。尽管商用电动汽车（电动卡车和公共车队）占中国电动汽车保有量的比例不到 10%，但到 2023 年，它们将带来 48% 的气候效益和 60% 的健康效益，这一比例将增至 52% 和 60%。到 2030 年，这一比例将达到 71%，其中电动卡车将推动未来的大部分增长。虽然电动卡车在一些煤炭密集地区尚未对气候有益，但正在进行的电网脱碳将很快在全国范围内解决气候问题。到 2030 年，最贫困的 50% 人口将只能从乘用电动汽车的采用中获得 33% 的健康益处，但近一半 (47%) 可以从电动卡车和公共车队中获得。与乘用电动汽车带来的不平衡、有收入偏见的健康效益不同，商业车队的电气化带来了主导性的、更公平的收益，凸显了它是实现低碳出行的高效、公正的途径。

articles.title:
Remote Calibrating
a National-Wide Dense Low-Cost
Sensor Network for Hyperlocal Air Surveillance
articles.abstract: Abstract Emerging low-cost sensor (LCS) technologies offer a unique opportunity to achieve equitable, high-granularity air surveillance. Yet without proper calibration, their raw observations are often considered invalid for rigorous research and regulatory purposes. Common calibration practices require “case-by-case” colocation of low-cost sensors against “gold standard” reference stations, lacking scalability for decentralized, dense sensor networks. This study proposes a scalable remote calibration framework that eliminates physical colocation by integrating metropolis-specific monthly updates with a spatiotemporal pairing algorithm for representative training data selection. We validate this approach using over 33 million hourly observations from the largest U.S. low-cost sensor network across ten major metropolitan areas. The calibrated LCS observations exhibit good agreement with reference stations in all regions. We further observe that the spatial distribution of LCS varies significantly across racial/ethnic and income groups, with African American communities the least covered. The usefulness of calibrated LCS observations is demonstrated through exemplary applications of high-granularity land use regression and wildfire plume tracking. Our study serves as a cornerstone in advancing the use of large-scale LCS networks, from citizen science and public awareness to rigorous air quality research and policymaking.
articles.title_zh:
远程校准
全国范围的密集低成本
用于超本地空中监视的传感器网络
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 新兴的低成本传感器（LCS）技术为实现公平、高粒度的空中监视提供了独特的机会。然而，如果没有适当的校准，他们的原始观察结果通常被认为对于严格的研究和监管目的是无效的。常见的校准实践需要将低成本传感器与“黄金标准”参考站“逐案”并置，缺乏分散、密集的传感器网络的可扩展性。本研究提出了一种可扩展的远程校准框架，通过将城市特定的每月更新与用于代表性训练数据选择的时空配对算法相结合，消除了物理主机托管。我们利用美国最大的低成本传感器网络在十个主要大都市地区每小时进行的超过 3300 万次观测来验证这种方法。校准后的 LCS 观测结果与所有地区的参考站都表现出良好的一致性。我们进一步观察到，LCS 的空间分布在不同种族/族裔和收入群体之间存在显着差异，其中非裔美国人社区覆盖率最低。通过高粒度土地利用回归和野火羽流跟踪的示例性应用，证明了校准 LCS 观测的有用性。我们的研究是推进大规模濒海战斗舰网络的使用的基石，从公民科学和公众意识到严格的空气质量研究和政策制定。

articles.title:
A
Diffusion-Driven CH4–O2 Boundary Structures
Methane Oxidation and Carbon Transformation
in Upland Soils
articles.abstract: Abstract Although extensive work has characterized high-affinity atmospheric methane oxidation in upland soils and sustained oxidation in chronically methane-rich environments, shallow point-source inputs introduce transient methane pulses into otherwise aerated heterotrophic soils. Whether these pulses migrate rapidly toward the atmosphere or instead create localized redox boundaries that restructure soil carbon pools and microbial metabolism remains unclear. Here, we conducted a controlled natural gas release experiment to quantify coupled geochemical and microbial responses in near-surface soils across a methane gradient. The release produced a spatial interval where measured CH4 and reconstructed O2 availability overlapped, identifying a redox transition associated with shifts in carbon geochemistry and methane-oxidation-related functional potential. Spatially resolved δ13C and C:N measurements revealed strong 13C enrichment of soil organic carbon (SOC) at the plume center, while elevated carbonate abundance and isotope composition distinguished a geochemical transition between the methane-rich plume center and distal reference soils. Within the intermediate CH4–O2 overlap zone, methane-associated monooxygenases (MMOs) and C1 assimilation genes were coordinately enriched, supporting structured C1 metabolic potential across the redox boundary. Metagenomic assembly and reconstruction linked this methane-responsive interval to Actinomycetota-affiliated genomes encoding expanded monooxygenase repertoires, including sMMO-like systems supported by operon architecture and catalytic-subunit phylogeny. This association provides a mechanistic link between transient methane exposure, redox-boundary formation, and microbial carbon transformation in aerated soils. Together, these findings show that shallow methane inputs can generate spatially constrained biogeochemical hotspots where gas transport, carbonate accumulation, and monooxygenase-associated C1 assimilation converge, and define conditions under which soil processes may influence methane transport toward the atmosphere.
articles.title_zh:
一个
扩散驱动的 CH4–O2 边界结构
甲烷氧化和碳转化
在高地土壤中
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要：虽然大量的工作已经描述了高地土壤中的高亲和性大气甲烷氧化和长期富含甲烷的环境中的持续氧化，但浅层点源输入将瞬态甲烷脉冲引入了其他通气异养土壤中。这些脉冲是否会快速迁移到大气中，还是会产生局部氧化还原边界来重组土壤碳库和微生物代谢，目前尚不清楚。在这里，我们进行了受控天然气释放实验，以量化甲烷梯度上近地表土壤中的地球化学和微生物耦合反应。这次释放产生了一个空间区间，其中测得的 CH4 和重建的 O2 可用性重叠，识别出与碳地球化学变化和甲烷氧化相关功能潜力相关的氧化还原转变。空间分辨的 δ13C 和 C:N 测量揭示了羽流中心土壤有机碳 (SOC) 的 13C 强烈富集，而碳酸盐丰度和同位素组成的升高区分了富含甲烷的羽流中心和远端参考土壤之间的地球化学转变。在中间 CH4-O2 重叠区内，甲烷相关单加氧酶 (MMO) 和 C1 同化基因协同富集，支持跨越氧化还原边界的结构化 C1 代谢潜力。宏基因组组装和重建将这种甲烷响应区间与编码扩展单加氧酶库的放线菌相关基因组联系起来，包括由操纵子结构和催化亚基系统发育支持的类 sMMO 系统。这种关联提供了通气土壤中瞬时甲烷暴露、氧化还原边界形成和微生物碳转化之间的机制联系。总之，这些发现表明，浅层甲烷输入可以产生空间受限的生物地球化学热点，其中气体传输、碳酸盐积累和单加氧酶相关的 C1 同化汇聚，并确定土壤过程可能影响甲烷向大气传输的条件。

articles.title:
The Shape-Selective
Suspension–Deposition Differentiation
of Microplastics in an Air–Snow System: Insights from a Northeastern
Polluted City in China
articles.abstract: Abstract Atmospheric microplastics (MPs) are increasingly recognized as important atmospheric pollutants, yet the role of particle physical properties in their suspension–deposition differentiation remains unclear. Here, MPs were simultaneously investigated in 31 total-suspended-particulate samples and 16 surface snow samples during a one-month winter period dominated by dry deposition in Changchun, Northeast China. Atmospheric MPs average 20.28 ± 5.62 MPs·m–3 (3.70 ± 1.55 μg·m–3). Snow MPs exhibit a cumulative behavior over time, with a mean concentration of (4.45 ± 2.32) × 104 MPs·L–1 ((1.49 ± 1.03) × 104 μg·L–1) and an average deposition load of (5.06 ± 2.74) × 105 MPs·m–2 ((1.74 ± 1.25) × 105 μg·m–2). Temporal patterns show that the proportions of fibers and films increase in the atmosphere but decrease in snow, whereas foams show the opposite trend. Particle shape best explains the differentiation of MPs between air and snow: deposited MPs exhibit higher sphericity and lower aspect ratios (ARs), whereas suspended MPs show an inverse pattern. Enrichment index analysis further confirms that AR is significantly associated with snow enrichment. These results provide direct field evidence for shape-selective enrichment of atmospheric MPs in snowpack under dry deposition dominated winter conditions in an urban environment.
articles.title_zh:
形状选择性
悬浮-沉积分化
空气-雪系统中的微塑料：来自东北部的见解
中国污染城市
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 大气微塑料（MP）越来越被认为是重要的大气污染物，但颗粒物理性质在其悬浮-沉积分化中的作用仍不清楚。在这里，在中国东北长春以干沉降为主的一个月冬季期间，同时对 31 个总悬浮颗粒物样品和 16 个地表雪样品中的 MP 进行了研究。大气 MP 平均值为 20.28 ± 5.62 MPs·m–3 (3.70 ± 1.55 µg·m–3)。雪MPs随着时间的推移表现出累积行为，平均浓度为（4.45±2.32）×104 MPs·L–1（（1.49±1.03）×104 μg·L–1），平均沉积负荷为（5.06±2.74）×105 MPs·m–2（（1.74±1.25）×105）微克·米–2）。时间模式表明，纤维和薄膜的比例在大气中增加，但在雪中减少，而泡沫则表现出相反的趋势。颗粒形状最好地解释了空气和雪之间 MP 的差异：沉积的 MP 表现出更高的球形度和更低的长宽比 (AR)，而悬浮的 MP 则表现出相反的模式。富集指数分析进一步证实AR与积雪富集显着相关。这些结果为城市环境中干燥沉积主导的冬季条件下积雪中大气 MP 的形状选择性富集提供了直接的现场证据。

articles.title:
Coprecipitated
Silica
Controls the Divergent Pathways
of Cysteine-Induced Ferrihydrite Transformation
articles.abstract: Abstract The reductive transformation of ferrihydrite (Fh) is a key process controlling iron mineral evolution and mineral-associated organic matter (MAOM) cycling in soils and sediments, yet the regulating role of coprecipitated silica remains poorly constrained. Here, we investigated the influence of coprecipitated silica on cysteine-induced Fh transformation under anoxic conditions using Fh and Si-Fh coprecipitates with Si/Fe molar ratios of 0.05 and 0.1. Mineral evolution and Fe speciation were monitored using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Mössbauer spectroscopy, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), transmission electron microscopy coupled with energy-dispersive X-ray analysis (TEM-EDX), and selective chemical extractions. In silica-free Fh, cysteine induced rapid transformation into lepidocrocite through reductive dissolution and recrystallization pathways that largely excluded silica and MAOM from the newly formed mineral phase. In contrast, coprecipitated silica altered the extent, rate, and pathway of mineral evolution. At a Si/Fe ratio of 0.05, crystalline phase formation was delayed and redirected toward a porous-like goethite phase that retained substantial silica and organic associations. At a Si/Fe ratio of 0.1, formation of crystalline secondary phases was strongly suppressed, coinciding with accumulation of labile surface-associated Fe(III). These findings demonstrate that coprecipitated silica can decouple reductive electron transfer from mineral recrystallization and alter the fate of MAOM during Fh transformation under anoxic conditions.
articles.title_zh:
共沉淀
二氧化硅
控制发散途径
半胱氨酸诱导的水铁矿转化
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 水铁矿（Fh）的还原转化是控制土壤和沉积物中铁矿物演化和矿物伴生有机物（MAOM）循环的关键过程，但共沉淀二氧化硅的调节作用仍然受到很少的限制。在这里，我们使用 Si/Fe 摩尔比为 0.05 和 0.1 的 Fh 和 Si-Fh 共沉淀物研究了缺氧条件下共沉淀二氧化硅对半胱氨酸诱导的 Fh 转化的影响。使用 X 射线衍射 (XRD)、穆斯堡尔能谱、X 射线光电子能谱 (XPS)、透射电子显微镜结合能量色散 X 射线分析 (TEM-EDX) 和选择性化学萃取来监测矿物演化和铁形态。在不含二氧化硅的 Fh 中，半胱氨酸通过还原溶解和重结晶途径诱导快速转化为纤铁矿，这在很大程度上将二氧化硅和 MAOM 从新形成的矿物相中排除。相反，共沉淀二氧化硅改变了矿物演化的范围、速率和途径。当 Si/Fe 比率为 0.05 时，结晶相的形成被延迟并重新定向为多孔状针铁矿相，保留了大量的二氧化硅和有机物。当 Si/Fe 比率为 0.1 时，结晶第二相的形成受到强烈抑制，同时伴随着不稳定表面相关 Fe(III) 的积累。这些发现表明，共沉淀二氧化硅可以将还原电子转移与矿物重结晶解耦，并改变缺氧条件下 Fh 转化过程中 MAOM 的命运。

articles.title:
Online Monitoring
of Residual Pyrethroids in Indoor
and Aquatic Environments: Advancing Fluorescence Sensing from Laboratory
to Field Deployment
articles.abstract: Abstract Pyrethroids, despite their widespread use in agriculture and household pest control, are often overlooked as persistent and potential toxicity contaminants. Their extensive applications lead to ubiquitous indoor and environmental residues, thereby raising risks to aquatic ecosystems and human health; however, effective on-site monitoring tools remain lacking. Herein, we pioneered an advanced indoor and environmental sensing device, i.e., the first online monitoring system for real-time detection of residual pyrethroids in waters. By designing a coumarin derivative that exhibited rapid and selective fluorescence enhancement upon binding to pyrethroids, a reversible sensor immobilized on a glass substrate was developed. Integrated into a Portable Online Monitoring Equipment (POME), this system enabled continuous, in situ monitoring and full signal regeneration within 5 min. The present method demonstrates excellent selectivity, stability across waters, and minimal environmental impact by virtue of zebrafish (Danio rerio) toxicity assays. This work bridges the gap between laboratory analysis and field-deployable sensing, offering a powerful tool for tracking these under-monitored pollutants and advancing real-time water quality assessment.
articles.title_zh:
在线监控
室内拟除虫菊酯残留量
和水生环境：推进实验室荧光传感
到现场部署
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 拟除虫菊酯尽管广泛用于农业和家庭害虫防治，但作为持久性和潜在毒性污染物，经常被忽视。它们的广泛应用导致室内和环境中普遍存在残留物，从而增加了对水生生态系统和人类健康的风险；然而，仍然缺乏有效的现场监测工具。在此，我们首创了先进的室内和环境传感装置，即第一个实时检测水中拟除虫菊酯残留的在线监测系统。通过设计一种在与拟除虫菊酯结合后表现出快速和选择性荧光增强的香豆素衍生物，开发了一种固定在玻璃基板上的可逆传感器。该系统集成到便携式在线监测设备 (POME) 中，可在 5 分钟内实现连续的原位监测和完整的信号再生。通过斑马鱼（Danio rerio）毒性测定，本方法表现出优异的选择性、跨水域稳定性和最小的环境影响。这项工作弥合了实验室分析和现场部署传感之间的差距，为跟踪这些监测不足的污染物和推进实时水质评估提供了强大的工具。
